gloss: rescue squad; ambulance crew; emergency response team

definitions.gloss: rescue squad; ambulance crew; emergency response team
definitions.explanation: A team of emergency medical personnel who respond to calls and provide prehospital care.

examples.japanese: {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The rescue squad arrived right away.

examples.japanese: {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ambulance crew transported the patient to the hospital.

examples.japanese: {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隊員|たいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A member of the rescue squad administered first aid at the scene.

notes:
In Japan, {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい} crews are part of the fire department (⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧), not a separate ambulance service. They are dispatched by calling 119, the emergency number for both fire and ambulance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}→救急隊員：22769_kyuukyuutaiin⟧ — rescue squad member; paramedic
- ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧ — ambulance
- {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — the rescue squad deploys
- {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}す→引き渡す：12486_hikiwatasu⟧ — to hand over to the rescue squad

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{救助隊|きゅうじょたい}→救助隊：23912_kyuujotai⟧ — rescue team (focused on rescuing people from danger, such as collapsed buildings)
- ⟦{消防隊|しょうぼうたい}→消防隊：29848_shouboutai⟧ — firefighting team (focused on extinguishing fires)
